    Hunt Night (Moonfang)¶

    [!INFO] The Wolf God hunts and the pretty are taken — Day 40, Month 12, the longest night on Moon Wolf Island Held on the 40th day of the 12th month (Ge'orian Calendar) — midwinter, when Moon Wolf Island does not see the sun.

    Origins¶

    Hunt Night (Moonfang) is the annual sacrifice rite of the Moonfang Dominion — the death cult on frozen Moon Wolf Island near the north pole, whose island itself is shaped like a wolf's head and whose god is Cleton, the Wolf God. The cult teaches that isolation is salvation, that the outside world is damned, that poverty is holy and beauty is the mark of Cleton's hunger. Each year, the prettiest children are selected and sent to Cleton Island — the barren rock caught between the two peninsulas that form the wolf's open mouth, as if the wolf itself is devouring its prey. The rite predates any calendar the cult will name. Its doctrine — codified in the hierarchy that rules Moonfang absolutely — is that Cleton demands youth to sustain the world's order, and that Wargs (massive wolf-predators that roam freely near settlements, sacred as the island's shape) are his messengers. To kill a warg is death. To question the selection is to be fed to him.

    Rituals¶

    • The Selection — priests parade the year's children; the prettiest are marked with a white ash handprint. Families are ordered to be grateful. The selected are dressed in undyed wool and walked — never carried — to the shore.
    • The Walk to Cleton — at dusk, the selected are ferried to Cleton Island in the wolf's mouth. No adult may remain on the island after the boat pulls away. None return. The faithful consider this an honor.
    • Night of the Warg Howl — Wargs are left unpenned. Settlements extinguish all but one lantern per house and listen to howling. A house whose lantern gutters is said to be noted by Cleton for next year.
    • Silence of the Molten South — on the Molten Archipelago to the far southwest, Karabar's refugee bases — where escapees find they have traded one cage for another in forced labor — keep a counter-rite: a silent line, no lanterns, facing north, remembering names the Dominion forbids speaking.

    Who Celebrates¶

    Moonfang Dominion on Moon Wolf Island — exclusively Humans, pale and lean from generations of cold, hunger, and fear. No other nation celebrates Hunt Night; Karabar's bases keep the counter-rite in grief, not worship. Even traders who winter near the Wolf Ocean give Moon Wolf Island a wide berth on this date — the only Ge'orian festival no outsider is invited to witness.

    Economics¶

    Moonfang has no mint. The cult teaches that wealth and ambition are sins against Cleton's design; poverty is holy.

    • Currency spent: Barter — no minted coin. The Dominion runs on barter in fangs, bones, dried fish, and warg-pelts (pelts may not be from a killed warg — only found dead are permitted, so the economy is literally scavenged). For external accounting — escapees paying Karabar boatmen, refugee base levies at the Molten Archipelago — prices are reckoned in Freeport Doubloon, the Freeport Concord coin of Karabar, Zahor, and the United Kingdom of the Seamen that any port honors. An escapee's passage south is quoted as "three fangs and a Doubloon."
    • On Hunt Night itself, no trade is permitted. To be caught bartering on Hunt Night is heresy.

    Connections¶

    • Religion: Cult of Cleton — Wolf God Cleton, child sacrifice on Cleton Island, sacred Wargs
    • Region: Moonfang Dominion — Moon Wolf Island (Wolf Ocean); counter-rite at Molten Archipelago (Karabar refuge)
    • Date: Day 40, Month 12 (Ge'orian Calendar) — midwinter longest night, annual selection
    • Currency used: Barter (fangs/bones) — no mint; external refuge trade in Freeport Doubloon; Wolf Ocean isolation
